raw_description:
Job Title: Bookkeeper

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Salary: 1000-1500 USD per month, paid in PHP or USD.

About Us

Better is a leading provider of telecommunications solutions, dedicated to delivering exceptional service to our customers. We pride ourselves on our innovative approach and commitment to customer satisfaction.

Role Overview

We're looking for a detail-oriented and organised Bookkeeper to join our growing team. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their career in finance within a fast-paced and supportive environment. You'll play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of our day-to-day financial operations.

Key Responsibilities

- Process payments and invoices accurately within our accounting system
- Reconcile bank statements and customer accounts to ensure accuracy
- Manage supplier payments and monitor upcoming payment schedules
- Support variance analysis across expense accounts
- Review and correct accounting entries, resolving any errors or duplicates
- Maintain accurate financial records and documentation

What we're looking for

- 3+ years of bookkeeping or accounts/finance experience
- Experience processing payments and invoices in an accounting context
- Experience reconciling bank statements and customer accounts
- Experience managing supplier payments and monitoring payment schedules
- Experience supporting variance analysis across expense accounts
- Experience reviewing and correcting accounting entries, including resolving errors or duplicates
- Experience maintaining accurate financial records and documentation
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other office tools
- Experience with Xero or Sage accounting systems is required
- Strong written and spoken English
- Work in a dynamic, supportive team.
- Competitive salary of 1000-1500 USD/month, paid in PHP or USD.
- Fully remote working environment.
- Access to Perkbox for discounts and rewards.
- Participate in our employee referral scheme.
- Monthly staff awards to celebrate achievements.
